_instructions: Copy this file to atip_data/config.json and fill in your API keys
_get_dhan: Login at https://web.dhanhq.com → My Profile → Apps → Create App. FREE for personal use.
_get_anthropic: Set as environment variable: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... from console.anthropic.com
_get_telegram_1: Create bot: open Telegram → search @BotFather → /newbot → copy token
_get_telegram_2: Get chat_id: message @userinfobot → copy the id number
_SECTION_4: === ZERODHA KITE (Optional — if using Zerodha for portfolio) ===
_get_kite: Create app at https://developers.kite.trade (Rs 2000/year). Skip if using Dhan portfolio.
_note: ATIP uses Dhan as primary data source. NSE Bhavcopy as backup for EOD. yfinance for global markets.
_SECTION_9: === RISK (orders/risk.py) — each limit is enforced only when set ===
_risk_limits_note: Rupees except max_drawdown_pct (%). max_daily_loss_value and max_drawdown_pct block new BUYs, measured on pnl_daily (portfolio/pnl.py); a loss limit that is set but cannot be measured also blocks.
_position_sizing_note: capital null = the account's equity. Used by order rules with quantity_type RISK and by orders.risk.size_position().
_SECTION_10: === BACKTESTING (backtest/config.py) — defaults for every backtest; a run stores its own snapshot ===
_backtest_note: cost_model: nse_delivery | nse_intraday | flat | zero (rates in backtest/costs.py - verify against a contract note). slippage kind: none | fixed (Rs/share) | pct (basis points).
_SECTION_11: === RISK ENGINE & EXECUTION (execution/config.py, W4) — PAPER by default; LIVE trading is disabled ===
_execution_note: LIVE needs mode LIVE AND live_trading_enabled true, and even then the W4 Dhan adapter refuses: live execution is not built. auto_execute_paper false = the post-market cycle evaluates risk only. paper_fill_price: live (Dhan LTP) | reference (decision close).
_w4_risk_limits_note: Percentages of equity unless stated; null disables a limit. PUT /api/risk/limits overrides these (stored in the risk_limit table). The W1 risk_limits above still apply on top.
_SECTION_12: === AI / ML (ml/config.py, W5) — off by default; ML never places orders ===
_ml_note: enabled: post-market predictions with every ACTIVE model version. default_model: whose ACTIVE predictions strategies see as ml_score / ml_prediction / ml_confidence / ml_prob_up. regime_source: deterministic | ml | hybrid (hybrid = the more defensive of Market Health and the regime model).
